mark: A section on the drawing: a square frame in the name's own ink with the pen's 45 degree hatch inside, the letters in the lettering (mono capitals sloped 15 degrees); a round mark is the compass circle. The current mark in a list has the pen's frame and the two amber witness lines at its ends.
stackbar: A dimensioned measure: every part is a hatched section in its own ink with a thin frame, the free rest an empty frame, the threshold the amber pointer on the scale. Pointing at a part sets the pen's frame round it and the amber witness lines on its legend row; legend names are lettering, figures the mono readout.
bullets: Rows that lead somewhere get the two amber witness lines at their ends on pointing, no wash and no underline. A warning figure is flagged with the outlined triangle before it, a failure with the filled one, in the tone's ink on no plate; the detail line is lettering.
tick: A live number that counts is read again: a short ruler is set under it with an amber pointer that slides from the old reading to the new on the plotter's feed and is then lifted; the number itself never moves.
uptime: Every period is a thin square section; the one you point at grows upward and focus is the pen's frame; the percentage is the mono readout, a failed summary is flagged with the filled triangle in the red on no plate; the axis is lettering.
uptime-states: Loading is the pen hatching the sections start to end in the strip; empty and failed keep the strip's footprint and say so in one line.
uptime-phone: At 390 px the strip scrolls sideways inside its box, the square sections keep their size and the card opens under the section.
inbox: Rows are lines on the sheet with a chain line on the start edge in the state's ink instead of a bar; a warning row is flagged with the outlined triangle before its title, a failed row with the filled one; the next row sits between two amber witness lines; meta lines are lettering.
backlog: The backlog with chain-line state edges, group headings in the lettering, done rows quieter by ink.
files: File rows with their meta in the lettering, and the payload opened as a dashed frame in the mono.
appointments: Appointments: the next one held between two amber witness lines, dates in the mono readout, past ones quiet.
checks: A check with a reservation is flagged: the outlined triangle before its name, its detail in the warning's ink; the fix written out stands under an amber leader line. A failed check keeps the filled triangle.
sort: Blueprint's own data table with the page's external sort: the sorted header shows the table's mark, the column that cannot be sorted now has none and no pointer.
kv: Labels are lettering beside upright values; a ruled list is a ruler with ticks along the foot of each row; a changed row carries the amber revision triangle after its label, a row that could not be read the filled red triangle before it.
formrows: Settings rows divided by rulers with ticks, labels and asides in the lettering, a changed row marked with the amber outlined triangle, a failed row with the red filled one, the lock lettered.
tiles: Choice tiles are parts on the sheet with no fill and no frame, a ruler along the start edge and the foot. Pointing sets the amber witness lines at the ends, a press adds the dimension across the foot, the chosen tile is a hatched section in the pen's frame, a disabled tile is the dashed ruler of a part not drawn.
card-states: A card in four data states: loading lays the shared loading card with the compass, empty is the compass mark with its dashed plate, failed is the red alert with a normal Retry. The card keeps its height.
header: The header lead is a hatched square mark, the title upright in the sans, the badge in the lettering, the freshness line a quiet readout that does not jump as it ticks.
art: Blueprint's own drawings: a working drawing. A part not yet drawn (corner marks, centre lines, the compass circle), a circle with a leader to an empty note, a part with the red filled triangle flagged, two parts on a centre line with the break between them, a hatched checked section, a part held under a padlock. The pen draws each stroke in cyan on the plotter's feed, half a unit apart, then it is inked in the finished line.
pipeline: Lanes are plates on the sheet (a ruler along the start edge and the foot, no fill, no frame); heads are hatched sections in the stage's ink with lettered names; cards are framed squares, with the amber witness lines when pointed at and the dimension across the foot when pressed; the open card has the pen's frame; dimmed cards are dashed.
pipeline-states: Loading lays the shared loading card with the compass; failed is a framed note with the filled triangle before its reason and a normal Retry; the board keeps its size.
journey: Square marks on one thin line: reached steps are hatched squares in the pen's cyan (or the step's ink) joined by a solid rule, the ones to come by a chain line, the step it stands at has the two amber witness lines at its sides. Names are lettering, dates the mono readout; a closed path ends in the red cross.
journey-states: Loading and empty journeys keep the stepper's height; the waiting pieces are blueprint's pen.
contact: The contact timeline: moments are hatched marks in their ink, planned ones hollow and dashed, pointing sets the pen's frame, a cluster count is lettering, a wait is a hatched band with a thin frame; the triangle mark stays solid so it can be read.
contact-states: Loading, empty and failed contact timelines keep the timeline's footprint; loading uses the shared loading card, failed has a normal Retry.
secret: While hidden the value is a covered section, hatched; shown it is a plain readout in the mono. The time left is an amber dimension line with a tick at each end that shortens from its end on the feed. A read failure is flagged with the filled triangle.
secret-phone: The same secret at 390 px: the buttons wrap under the value and the dimension line keeps its room.
manage: The dialog in sections: sections divided by a ruler, headings in the lettering, a danger section flagged with the filled triangle before its heading and no bar, dependents as a plate on the sheet.
confirm: The confirmation that depends on something: the dependents in a plate with a ruler along its start edge and foot, inside blueprint's overlay sheet that is drawn the way every blueprint dialog is.
type-dialog: The typed confirmation in its dialog: the loses plate with the filled triangle before its lettered title, the name to type as a readout with an amber dimension under it, the field and the confirm button as blueprint's.
type-own: The same typed confirmation on the page, the loses plate on the sheet and the name underlined by the amber dimension.
type-phone: The typed confirmation at 390 px: plate and field stack, the long name wraps in the readout.
disc: The timer is the compass circle with its centre lines; the time left is a 45 degree hatched section in the pen's cyan inside a thin frame; the hub is a small circle on the centre; marks are thin ticks.
disc-states: Paused is quieter; when time is up the disc is ringed by an amber dashed revision line, and the status line says so. Nothing glows or breathes.
disc-phone: The compass disc at 390 px: it scales with the box, buttons stay a normal size.
countdown: The countdown is a plate on the sheet (ruler along the start edge and foot); the digits are the mono readout, the name and status line are lettering.
countdown-states: Paused greys the digits; when ended the amber dimension line is drawn across the foot of the plate three times on the feed.
range: The preset track is blueprint's lettered segmented control; Custom, when it is the window in force, is a hatched section in the pen's frame; the line under it is lettering.
range-states: The wrong-range panel: the overlay sheet under its anchor, invalid fields framed red, a red sentence saying why.
wheel: A compass drawing: wedges are light washes between thin drawn lines, the rim one line, the pointer the amber pointer of the scale, Spin in the hub. It turns on the plotter's feed (up to speed, at speed, down) and stops; the caption is lettering.
cook: Cook mode: what the step needs is a plate on the sheet with its title in the lettering and the amounts as readouts; each step is constructed and drawn (the package's arrival in blueprint).
timers: Each timer is a plate on the sheet (ruler along the start edge and foot, no fill), the state in the lettering; a finished timer is flagged with the filled triangle before its state and never filled; a ringing one draws the amber dimension across its foot three times on the feed.
quantity: The number is a readout in the mono in a square frame, the unit is lettering, the minus and plus are blueprint's own buttons.
checklist: Rows are read on a scale when pointed at (two amber witness lines and a ruler along the foot, no wash); a ticked item is struck through in amber, the redline; titles, counts and details are lettering.
tri: The three-way chips: square marks, lettered chips; the chip that is in is a hatched section in the pen's frame, the one that is out has the red frame and its word struck through; pointing sets the amber witness lines.
code: The code block is a plate on the sheet (ruler along the start edge and the foot, no fill, no closed frame); the head is lettered; the text sits on a faint field of its own; keys are the pen's cyan.
command: The command block: a plate on the sheet, the head and the shell lettered, prompts in the pen's cyan, the place line in the lettering. Copy keeps its width.
command-long: A long command in the same plate: wrapping under the prompt with the hanging indent or scrolling in its box with the faded edge.
command-phone: The command block at 390 px: one-line head, wrapped code, nothing touching the edge.
compare: The comparison sits in a square frame; the divider is the pen's thin cyan line and the handle the compass circle with its centre line; Before and After are lettered labels on the sheet's ground.
compare-live: Loading lays the shared loading card with the compass over the frame; a failed image says so in its pane with a normal Retry; the divider glides on the plotter's feed.
